links.comparator_used: Original CSL PPH model applied as-is to the local EHR data (external validation without local refitting)
links.effect: Original CSL model AUC 0.60 (95% CI 0.58-0.61) vs refit XGBoost model AUC 0.75 (95% CI 0.74-0.76); PPH incidence 7.7% among 87,662 deliveries
links.tradeoff: The refit model remained poorly calibrated and overestimated PPH risk across a range of predicted probabilities.
links.quote: Refitting a new model with XGBoost resulted in improved discrimination with an AUC of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.74–0.76).

design_hint: local validation and refitting before deployment
